patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — OpenCart and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

OpenCart and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose OpenCart only if your buying job matches “GPL open-source PHP cart — free download core; optional managed cloud cited ~$59–$99/mo by” rather than Tiendanube's shape. Choose Tiendanube only if your buying job matches “LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Es” rather than OpenCart's shape. Workflow advantage differs because OpenCart is shaped for GPL open-source PHP cart — free download core; optional managed cloud  whereas Tiendanube is shaped for LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS t. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — OpenCart and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: OpenCart is GPL open-source PHP cart — free download core; optional managed cloud cited ~$59–$99/mo by secondary sources (confirm live). WooCommerce kee; Tiendanube is LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Esencial ~$20 USD, Impulso ~$59 highlighted, Escala .
- Researched limits: OpenCart — Hosting, security, and extension TCO are on you even when the license is $0; Tiendanube — Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market.

Limitations — OpenCart: Hosting, security, and extension TCO are on you even when the license is $0; Managed cloud floors are not first-party confirmed here — confirm live before budgeting; Tiendanube: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market; USD amounts are FX approximates; ARS tiles are the source of truth.

Poor-fit cases: OpenCart is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Hosting, security, and extension TCO are on you even when the license is $0 · Tiendanube is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market · Avoid OpenCart if you actually need Tiendanube's motion (LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inic)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
